$meta.name: Verst variant B «Дневная трасса» — day colour tokens (proposal, not merged into design/tokens.json)
$meta.scope: Windshield and Instruments mockups in design/variants-ir/b/. Type, spacing, radius, stroke and motion are shared with the night theme (design/tokens.json + the variant additions listed in design/variants-ir/README.md §6).
$meta.rule: Same token names as the night theme wherever the role is the same, so Kotlin can switch palettes by theme (DesignTokens.color ↔ DesignTokens.colorDay). Yellow is never used as text or a thin line on a light surface: on light it is only a filled plate with a dark border and dark text.
$meta.contrast: Every text/background pair is checked by design/variants-ir/tools/contrast.py (WCAG 2.2 AA: 4.5:1 text, 3:1 UI boundaries).

band1.use: Top sky band (day); under the mirror caption and the Instruments back link

band2.use: Sky band 2; Instruments strip lower band

liner.use: Roof liner and A-pillars (grey plastic in daylight)

rim.use: Dashboard top rim line; navigator bezel

divider.use: Hairline between control rows (decorative, not a boundary)

fill.use: Stepper keys, chips, switch-chip, settings row

border.use: 1 dp border of keys and unselected chips (WCAG 1.4.11 ≥ 3:1)

shadow.use: Inset bottom edge of keys (0 −3 dp), same geometry as shadow.key

fill.use: Instrument well face (odometer and gauge summaries)

gaugeFill.use: Gauge arc: estimate share of the budget (= sign.blue)

gaugeTick.use: Budget limit tick on the arc

onCta.use: Text on the yellow CTA plate

blueText.use: Meaning line and footnote on the sign

yellowOnSign.use: Pressed-row text on the blue sign (yellow text only on dark blue)

border.use: 2 dp inner border of the CTA plate — carries the 3:1 boundary on light

selectedBorder.use: Selected chip 2 dp border; radio dot

bezel.use: Mirror bezel and stem (black plastic, same in day)

bench.use: Back bench in the summary mirror

label.use: Crew caption under the mirror (on sky.band1)

child.use: Child silhouette (darker yellow to read on the light bench)

focus.use: Keyboard focus ring 2 dp, offset 2 dp (yellow fails on light)
